changes.text: Keep at least 20% in GBP money market until the Fed and BoE paths are clear
changes.rationale: Dry powder earning ~Bank Rate during a hiking cycle; lets the agent buy dislocations after FOMC 27-28 Oct and BoE 5 Nov

changes.text: Halve energy exposure if Brent closes below its 50-day average
changes.rationale: Energy is the core inflation trade; a break in oil's trend is the first sign the regime is turning

changes.text: Rotate money market into gilts if the US 10-year falls 30bp from 5.22% or payrolls turn negative
changes.rationale: Pre-commits the pivot trade so the agent acts on the regime change instead of debating it

changes.text: Volatility regime: if VIX closes above 25, halve equity exposure into money market; if below 15, allow +10% equity
changes.rationale: Equity risk premia are best harvested in calm regimes and protected in stressed ones; VIX is the market's own fear gauge

amendments.grant: owner: three rule turns per agent, round-robin, 2026-10-13: round 1

changes.text: War-risk insurance: hold 10% in gold while Brent is above $90
changes.rationale: Oil above $90 signals live Middle East risk; gold hedges a geopolitical shock that would hurt the rest of the book

amendments.grant: owner: three rule turns per agent, round-robin, 2026-10-13: round 2

changes.text: FOMC playbook: if the Fed holds on 28 Oct and signals no further hikes, move 20% from money market into long gilts the same day
changes.rationale: Pre-commits the pivot trade; the biggest macro gains come from acting first on a regime change

amendments.grant: owner: three rule turns per agent, round-robin, 2026-10-13: round 3

changes.text: BREAK OUT: short long gilts (IGLT) at 15% of equity as a term-premium trade until the MAC-6 pivot trigger fires
changes.rationale: Sticky 3%+ inflation, a hiking Fed and rising global yields (US 10y 5.2%, +29bp in a month) push long-gilt prices down; the money-market sleeve already pays Bank Rate
breakout: left the ISA wrapper (shorting, crypto ETNs, US ETFs allowed)
